description: Quote the exact Gold price to animate an owned gallery image. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_generate_image_to_video with the same inputs and quote_token.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio supported by the model, such as 16:9.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds, where supported by the model.

model.description: Enabled video model supporting image-to-video; chargen_list_media_models can help choose a model. This never changes the operation.

negative_prompt.description: Things to keep out of the result, as a short list. Only some models take one: chargen_list_media_models shows negative_prompt in that model's settings, and any other model refuses this argument.

prompt.description: What moves and how, not what the picture already shows. chargen_list_media_models with this mode says how to phrase it for each model (prompt_styles); nothing improves the wording on the way to the model.

prompt_expansion.description: Let the video model rewrite and lengthen the prompt before it renders, where the model offers it (chargen_list_media_models shows prompt_expansion in its settings). Off by default; leave it off for a prompt written in full.

resolution.description: Resolution supported by the model, such as 720p.

source_image_id.description: Owned still image to animate or use as the portrait.

name: chargen_quote_image_to_video
title: Quote image to video
